title: fix(console): open the record page scoped to the current app (PageSchema.apps)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbS1gR5cGSSfRihXeXjmJC3p)_
Fixes #29592

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：控制台打开记录页时，先看当前应用：某张记录页在 `apps` 里列了这个应用，就在该应用里打开它；其它地方(含 Setup)照旧打开对象唯一的默认记录页。记录抽屉同样生效。`page.apps` 的活性登记从 planned 改为 live，描述去掉 PLANNED 标记。
- **为什么改**：#28979 裁决 A 的 ui 半。规格半(PR #29437)已合入，但控制台没读 `apps`，所以 Duly 这类应用在自己的路由里打开用户记录，仍然看到平台的 `sys_user_detail`。
- **风险与回滚**：没有任何页面写 `apps` 时行为不变(测试有对照组，现有 291 个相关测试文件全绿)。路由段先解析成应用再比对应用名，不拿包 id 去比。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts`(选页顺序：应用页、默认页、声明顺序)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`(路由段解析为应用名)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`(`declaredRecordPage` 与渲染选同一张页)。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.appScopedPage-29592.test.tsx`，应见 6 个用例全绿：Duly 应用里打开 `duly_member`，Setup 里仍是 `sys_user_detail`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Ruling A on #28979 lets a record page name the apps whose routes open it (`PageSchema.apps`); the spec half landed in #29437. This is the console half.

- **`usePageAssignment` (`@object-ui/react`)** now reads its existing `app` option, the owning app's NAME. Order: the first record page of the object for which `defaultRecordPageObject(page, app)` answers the object, then the `isDefault` page, then declaration order. The option's type is unchanged; it was declared "reserved for future use" and read by nothing, and its only caller never passed it. No new parameter, so `Clause-②: no` (seat ruling).
- **`RecordDetailView`** resolves the route's `:appName` segment with `matchAppBySegment` over the full metadata app list and passes `app.name`, never the raw segment (contract-review flag ③.2 on #29437: the segment is `app._packageId ?? app.name`). The record drawer, mounted under the host list route, reads the same segment, so a record opened in the drawer inside an app gets that app's page too. A package that ships two apps resolves its package-id segment to the first app, so the second app's scoped page opens under its name segment only, as the `appAddressSegment` docblock states.
- **`appObjectScope.ts` `declaredRecordPage`** (the record route's object scope, objectui#13046) asks the same order with the app `AppContent` already resolved, so the route reads the objects of the page it renders. Only this picker was touched; the packaged-lookup and package-less arms are untouched.
- **Spec (the one edit the card owes, as amended):** `page.apps` liveness row `planned` → `live`, citing the three console read points; the describe drops `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and the closing "Until the console reads it" sentence, and the TSDoc names the renderer. Forced by that: the describe pin in `stack-app-record-page.test.ts` now pins the marker's absence; `liveness/state-counts/page.md` and `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx` are regenerated. The `page.apps` omit row in `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` stays, with a rewritten reason: live, but not offered in the Studio page form because no registered widget spells a list of app names (seat ruling; whether the form offer becomes a follow-up card is the seat's call at ACCEPT).

With no `apps` on any page, every branch falls through to the previous line.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/usePageAssignment.appScope-29592.test.tsx` (10): the scoped page opens in its app whatever the served order; Setup and no-app open the default; a page listing several apps; declaration-order fallthrough; another object's scoped page ignored; scoped slotted page hands back slots; `pageName` still wins; CONTROL with no `apps`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.appScopedPage-29592.test.tsx` (6): the ruling's pin (Duly under `com.duly` and under `duly` opens `duly_member`; `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/...` opens `sys_user_detail`), the two-apps-one-package corner, the drawer, and the CONTROL over five segments.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope.appScopedRecordPage-29592.test.tsx` (3): the scope reads the scoped page's objects in Duly and the default's in Setup; the scope picker and `usePageAssignment` agree across apps and orders; CONTROL.
- Existing assignment tests unchanged and green: `usePageAssignment.isDefault-12195`, `.typeDiscriminator-9674`, `.declarationOrder-7298`, `.isRecordPageOf-12715`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD and verified)</summary>

- A, compare the raw segment (`matchAppBySegment(metadataApps, appName)?.name` → the segment): record-view suite 3 failed / 3 passed (package-id segment, two-apps corner, drawer red; the name segment stays green, as expected).
- B, the hook ignores the app (`if (opts.app && false)`): 8 failed / 11 passed across the three new files.
- C, the scope picker ignores the app: 2 failed / 1 passed in the agreement file.
</details>

<details><summary>Sweep</summary>

Every ui test file naming `RecordDetailView`, `appObjectScope`, `usePageAssignment` or `readAppObjectScope` (291 files, `git grep -l` at 8fead845), three locked batches at 2 workers: 98/98 files 788 tests, 98/98 files 654 tests, 95/95 files 847 tests. Spec: `src/stack-app-record-page.test.ts` + `src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` 103/103. `check:liveness` and `check:generated` green after regeneration.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Live measurement (app-crm `--fresh` backend, Vite console on this branch's source, 1440×900): a record page `crm_member` for `sys_user` with `apps: ['crm_app']` was saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/crm_member` (200). Under `/apps/com.example.crm/sys_user/record/ID` it opens `crm_member`; `/apps/crm_app/...` canonicalises to the package-id segment and opens it too; `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user/record/ID` opens `sys_user_detail`. Before leg (the three ui files restored from `origin/main` in the same running console): the CRM route opened `sys_user_detail`. Screenshots are in the project files under `issue-29592/` (`before-crm-app-user-record.png`, `after-crm-app-user-record.png`, `after-setup-users-record.png`); the seat links them.
- The record drawer is included by seat ruling; its host is `RecordDetailView` mounted with `embedded` under the list route (`/apps/:appName/:objectName`).
- The Studio page form does not offer `apps` (no app-name widget); see the reconciliation ledger row.

## Verification

Local, `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 107 families on this diff: all 107 run at `0275f773`, every one exit 0, `--ran` reconciliation `107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (the ui `vitest run scripts/` suite and `check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock: 170 files / 4972 tests green; debt exit 0). `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate (`page.zod.ts` is a Clause-② suspect hint only; the change there is describe text).

After merging `main` (`5b257756`, which brought #29552's `appObjectScope.ts` arm in cleanly): spec rebuilt, `check:generated` and `check:liveness` exit 0; the 16 ui test files naming `appObjectScope` / `readAppObjectScope` / `usePageAssignment` plus the record-view file and #29552's new test, 18 files / 113 tests green; the two spec files 103/103; ratchets rerun on the new head: `check:type-check-debt`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes` exit 0. Type-check (`@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@objectstack/spec`) exit 0 and eslint 0 errors on the touched ui files, both at `0275f773`. CI check-runs: see this PR.
